findings.description: Critical: check_test_contract.scan_unified_diff ignores deleted test files (+++ /dev/null). Removed assertion lines on deleted tests produce zero findings, so a simplify that deletes characterization tests can pass the contract check.
findings.resolution: Track path from --- lines when +++ is /dev/null; still scan -assert lines for that path.

findings.description: Nit: verify_behavior_preservation module docstring claims a git-stash fallback when worktree fails, but dual_run only uses worktree and raises on failure.
findings.resolution: Align docstring with implementation (worktree-only) or implement the documented fallback.

findings.description: Nit: dual-run HEAD path executes --test-cmd in the live working tree, so uncommitted dirty files can make HEAD results non-reproducible relative to head_sha.
findings.resolution: Run HEAD tests in a detached worktree at head_sha (same as baseline), or refuse to run when git status is dirty.

findings.description: Nit: check_test_contract module docstring says characterization commits that add tests are fine, but the scanner flags every +assert line including pure additions. Correct only when --base is set after pin; docstring overpromises.
findings.resolution: Clarify docstring: set --base to the post-characterization tip; pure +assert in range fails intentionally.

findings.description: FYI: verify_behavior_preservation runs --test-cmd with shell=True. Acceptable for operator-supplied pytest/npm commands but unsafe if args come from untrusted input.
findings.resolution: Document that --test-cmd is trusted local shell; optional future: argv list mode without shell.

findings.description: none: Skill contract, OpenSpec delta, dual-run exit codes (0/1/2), and tech-debt remediation routing are coherent and match the approved A+B+C design.
